items.text: Next: Web Worker meshing, survival mining, day/night.
Endless seeded world in 16×16×128 chunks, streamed around the player.
Biomes: Meadow, Duskwood, Dunes, Frostland, Peaks, Shore, Ocean.
Caves and the hollows: deep caverns lit by Lumen crystals with real block light.
19 original blocks with procedurally painted textures.
Smooth ambient occlusion, sky light, gradient sky and underwater fog.
Walking, sprinting, sneaking, swimming and flying with voxel collision.
Break, place and pick blocks; 9-slot hotbar and block picker (E).
Automatic saves in IndexedDB; world list to create, play and delete worlds.
Settings: render distance, field of view, mouse sensitivity.
Dev hub site with devlog, roadmap board, and changelog.
Originality rules to keep the project legally distinct.
Initial roadmap: milestones M0 to M7.
